evidenceTiers.A: explicit public units sold counter or direct merchant feed
evidenceTiers.B: public popularity/bestseller order; WooCommerce popularity is cumulative total_sales and has no period attribution
evidenceTiers.C: other demand proxy; never labelled sales

methodology.unitsSoldRule: first cumulative counter observation is baseline; only positive snapshot deltas are period sales
methodology.rankingRule: WooCommerce popularity is a lifetime cumulative order. Daily rank movement is retained separately, but the rank itself is never labelled sales for 01.01.2026-present.
methodology.marketShareRule: national unit/value shares only with full comparable Tier-A coverage
methodology.historicalTruthRule: No comparable snapshots exist before the first observed date. The requested 01.01.2026 start is shown, but missing history is never backfilled or estimated.
